column2: Match the approved Capital paint-overs in Card Game Art / Paintovers (PAINTOVER-CAP-*) and the quality of PAINTOVER-TOWN.png. The Capital is ONE zone in two halves. OUTSIDE the walls (rows marked OUTSIDE): bleak, drained wasteland at flat eerie overcast dusk; ash, cracked roads, ruined outposts, purple magical rifts tearing the sky and ground. Palette: ash gray #8C8A86, charcoal #5E5B57, bone #B9B2A4, dust cream #D8D0C0, rift purple #9B59D0 (accents only). INSIDE the walls (rows marked INSIDE): Primm's Perfection, an eerily perfect pastel town at flat, shadowless, unnatural noon; identical houses, perfect symmetry, white-and-gold civic buildings, Primm's smiling face everywhere; quietly wrong. Palette: porcelain white #F7F3EA, gold #E6C35C, pastel pink #F5C6D0, mint #BFE3D0, sky blue #A7C7E7, lawn green #7FC97F. PAINTED, not pixel art: clean bold shapes, soft cel-shaded painting. No text or letters anywhere.
Seamless, tileable, hand-painted texture viewed perfectly straight-on (orthographic). Flat, even, neutral lighting. Evenly distributed detail; edges match so it tiles. Square 1024x1024.

A single hand-painted object or detail, viewed straight-on (or from the low game camera for props), centered, fully transparent background (PNG). Soft painted shading, no cast shadow outside the object, crisp edges. Slightly oversized storybook proportions.

6 related items on ONE transparent image in a 3x2 grid, each centered in its cell with wide clear empty gaps (nothing touching), same scale and lighting, viewed straight-on. Claude slices them apart. 2048x1365 (or 1536x1024).

A single hand-painted tree or plant seen from a low camera slightly above (about 25 degrees down), storybook shapes, base at the bottom center, fully transparent background, no ground or cast shadow. 1024x1536.

Concept: the landmark alone in a three-quarter view from the low game camera, plain flat light background, clear silhouette, a 1.7 m person beside it for scale. Backdrop: a wide distant-scenery layer along the bottom with a transparent sky above, atmospheric haze; left and right edges match if noted.

Save to Card Game Art / Pending Review; approved files go to Card Game Art / Approved_ZoneKits / Capital. Reused from earlier batches (don't remake): TEX-CAP-ASH, -DEADGRASS, -CRACKEDROAD, -PASTELPLAZA, -PERFECTLAWN, -WHITEWALL, DEC-RIFT, DEC-CRACKS, DEC-SCORCH, and the shared ENV-* kit. The four service districts (Transit Yards, Hungry Quarter, Grave Row, The Reek) appear BROKEN until their Path zone is freed, then RESTORED: their concepts show both states side by side.

column5: Image Description (paste STYLE TARGET + the Lock first)

INSIDE. The final goal of the whole game: an immense, gleaming white-and-gold palace on a hill at the heart of the city, perfectly symmetrical, with soaring spires, mirrored windows, a grand stair, and a colossal smiling Primm emblem over the doors. Hairline cracks and faint purple rift light leak from it. Magnificent and cold; must be visible from both halves of the Capital and over the walls from far outside.

OUTSIDE. The huge, flawless white wall around the city with an enormous gold-trimmed gate, a smiling Primm emblem above it; perfect and pristine against the ruined ashen land in front of it, a few cracks starting to show.
